purpose: Measure whether an X-of-Y queue plus AI adjudication can outperform both strict gates and approve-all quorum candidates.
capital_for_comparison: 3 independent $1000 symbol sleeves; compare percentages, not nominal PnL
selection_rule: Choose the highest development PF only if PF > 1.0, net PnL > 0 and at least 30 filled trades. Otherwise no approve-all quorum qualifies and locked evaluation remains unused for threshold selection.

development_results_before_final_executi.note: Diagnostic only: these runs exposed that S12AI fell through to legacy S3 entry geometry. They are invalidated and must be rerun after the dedicated mid-FVG execution fix.

valid_development_results.execution: dedicated S12AI 50% FVG resting limit, structural stop, <=5x leverage, causal bars and full costs

development_decision.reason: No candidate met PF > 1 and positive-PnL requirements.
development_decision.prospective_shadow_collection_policy: Q7-S2 (7/9, minimum 2/3 structural) solely because it offers the least-bad base PF and enough observations to test incremental AI selection.

ai_claim_rule: AI adds value only if prospective APPROVE trades beat the counterfactual REJECT cohort after identical costs, with at least 100 resolved candidates and lower drawdown.
safety: S12AI is shadow_only, saved L2 decisions are dismissed, and execution is hard-disabled in settings.
disclosures: All historical price months were seen by earlier strategy work; this is not a pristine market holdout.
The actual language-model selector cannot be backtested without timestamped historical model outputs.
Approve-all results measure queue quality, not AI performance.
